issues: A 560x380 skeleton placeholder card in the middle of a light grey floor, with a debug title "DRAW SVG TRACE" in the corner; the subject covered only 29% of the width
The first 8 frames were completely blank, and during the trace the frame held a single thin line in a sea of empty white
After the handoff the card content was grey placeholder bars, and the underline was drawn under a grey bar: there was no actual key word
The background was flat grey with no paper texture or light, disconnected from the pen-and-ink metaphor
changes: Paper look (warm white paper, ink, vermilion) with the subject enlarged to 1120x660 (58% of the width): a publication-grade quarterly metric card with a mono kicker, a two-part headline "Revenue grew / 38%" (38% at 212px, weight 820), a 32px note, a 12-bar chart with the last three in vermilion and a byline
Something on screen from frame 1: a drafting dot grid sharp in the centre and fading out, plus crop marks growing from the four corners (staggered 2f) that spring outward and fade on closure

A more convincing pen: a 6px line with a three-step tapering nib and a solid pen tip placed exactly by rounded-rect arc length, with a drop shadow; on closure the stroke hits pure black and 11px in 2f and settles over 6f (no glow on white)

Layered inking: the card lifts off the paper as its shadow grows, content resolves top to bottom with 3f staggers from blur and a small rise, bars grow from the baseline in sequence; the second use draws a hand-curved vermilion marker underline under "38%"
Duration 126f to 132f: 10f preview, 40f trace, 16f handoff, 18f underline, 40f hold with a 0.9% push-in
